start.label: Start
start.description: Count up: pressed by the button, counts one more.

code.label: Add one
code.description: Adds one. It reads the count as it was when the round began, and writes the new count back.

data.label: The count
data.description: The count: how many times the tool was started. It starts empty, at 0.

end.label: Result
end.description: How many times the tool was started.

inputs.name: Path
inputs.description: Optional: a wired file or folder path, used instead of the one set above.
